notes: Assumptions: a 1.8 kg bird gives ~1100 g raw meat and skin (61 %, USDA yield for ready-to-cook chicken), valued as broiler meat and skin — a hardbody bird is leaner, so this may overstate slightly; the cooking water boils away and the fat stays in the pot and is eaten; the 1 tbsp oil counted as written. Sanity check: FatSecret chicken stew recipe 314 kcal and SparkPeople chicken and vegetable stew 389.5 kcal a serving; USDA stewed meat and skin is 219 kcal/100 g, and ours is ~180 g of it plus gravy, 460 kcal — 18 % above the SparkPeople figure, which uses skinless meat.
